root.name: Italian Game: Bird's Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. c3 Nf6 5. b4

overview: White offers the b-pawn with 5.b4, an Evans-like thrust, hoping to win time against the bishop and build a central pawn pair with d4. Black normally declines with 5...Bb6 6.a4 a6 7.a5 Ba7, after which White gets d4 and a strong centre while Black's bishop is shut in on a7. Taking with 5...Bxb4 6.cxb4 Nxb4 is the dangerous gambit line.

white_ideas.idea: Gain space on the queenside with b4, a4 and a5, trapping the bishop on a7.
Build a big centre with d4 and use the open lines for an attack on f7.

black_ideas.idea: Decline with ...Bb6 and strike back with ...d5 or ...a6 and ...d6.
Accept with ...Bxb4 and defend accurately, returning the pawns when needed.

typical_structures.structure: White pawns on b4, c3 and d4 after a4-a5, Black bishop on a7 with an open centre.

character.notes: Open centre with a space grab and pressure against f7; double-edged but not forced.

gambit.notes: In the main line 5...Bb6 the pawn is declined, so no material changes hands.

soundness.notes: Playable for both; a respectable sideline.

structure.notes: The centre opens after d4 and exd4, with open lines for the pieces.

approach.notes: A rare sideline used for surprise.

level.notes: Needs sound tactical and positional judgment but little theory.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5...Bxb4 6.cxb4 Nxb4
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. c3 Nf6 5. b4 Bxb4 6. cxb4 Nxb4
sublines_that_differ.how: Black accepts and grabs two pawns for the centre; a real gambit.

character.reason: Open centre but the main line is declined with no forced tactics.

gambit.reason: The main line 5...Bb6 declines, so no material is given.

structure.reason: d4 breaks the centre open for the pieces.

approach.reason: A seldom-used sideline of the Italian.

plans.reason: White advances the b and a pawns and builds a centre.
